text: # Memorandum

**To** Board of Directors
**From** Group Chief Financial Officer
**Date** 21 June 2024
**Subject** Cost programme and reporting changes for the second half

## 1. Cost reduction target

The Board approved a target to reduce group operating expenses by **4 per cent**
against the 2024 plan in the second half of the year, with the reduction weighted
towards discretionary categories: travel, marketing and third-party consulting.
Personnel and facilities costs are out of scope for the current programme.

## 2. Americas reorganisation

Following the reorganisation effective **01 July 2024**,
the cost centre previously reported as **OPS-NA** is reported as
**OPS-AMER**. The 2024 plan has been restated onto the new code for the full
year. Prior-year comparatives have **not** been restated and remain on the former
code. Analysts should map the two codes when presenting any comparison that spans
the effective date.

## 3. Chart of accounts

Client entertainment previously recorded under Travel & Entertainment has been
reclassified with effect from the same date, to align external reporting with the
way the commercial team manages the spend. The chart of accounts carries both the
former and the current parent with validity dates; the underlying account code is
unchanged.

## 4. Freight

Expedited freight has run materially ahead of plan in the Americas following the
tooling failure on line 3 in July. Operations expect the position to normalise in
the fourth quarter. The Board asked that the full-year effect be quantified at
the next meeting.

## 5. Headcount

Headcount reporting is produced by the People team in the HR system and is not
maintained in the finance ledger. The Board's request for a cost-per-head series
will be met from the HR system separately.

text: # Master Services Agreement — Kestrel Freight Systems

Between Meridian Instruments Inc. ("Customer") and Kestrel Freight Systems ("Carrier").
Commencement 1 January 2023. Initial term 36 months.

## 3. Charges

3.1 Carrier shall invoice Customer monthly for services performed, at the rates
set out in Schedule B.

3.2 Charges are stated exclusive of fuel surcharge, which is applied at the
index published on the first business day of each month.

## 4. Volume rebate

4.1 Where Customer's aggregate charges under this Agreement in any calendar year
exceed **USD 500,000**, Carrier shall credit Customer
**4 per cent** of the amount by which the aggregate exceeds
that threshold.

4.2 The rebate is calculated on charges net of credit memos and is settled by
credit note within 90 days of the calendar year end. Rebates are **not** applied
against invoices during the year to which they relate.

## 5. Payment terms

Net 45 days from invoice date. Customer may withhold disputed amounts provided
the dispute is raised within 20 days of invoice.

## 9. Liability

Carrier's aggregate liability is limited to the charges paid in the twelve months
preceding the claim.

summary:
text: # Meridian Instruments — Travel & Entertainment Policy

Version 4.2 · effective 1 January 2023 · owner: Group Controller

## Scope

Applies to all employees of Meridian Instruments Inc., Meridian Instruments
Canada Ltd. and Meridian Instruments B.V. Amounts are stated in US dollars;
where an expense is incurred in another currency, the local equivalent at the
month-end rate applies.

## Air travel

Economy class is required for all scheduled flights with a total duration under
six hours. Business class may be booked for flights over six hours with the
written approval of a Vice President.

## Lodging

Nightly room rates must not exceed **USD 275** in tier-one cities and
**USD 190** elsewhere. Tier-one cities are: New York, San Francisco, Chicago, Boston, London, Amsterdam, Toronto, Zurich.
Rates are exclusive of local tax. Where a stay exceeds the applicable cap,
the difference is not reimbursable and must be recharged to the employee.

## Meals

A per-diem of **USD 85 per day** applies to employee meals while travelling.
Receipts are not required within the per-diem.

## Client entertainment

Client entertainment over **USD 500** per event requires the sign-off of a Vice
President in advance of the event. The names and employers of all attendees must
be recorded.

## Pre-approval

Any single expense of **USD 1,000 or more** requires documented pre-approval
before the commitment is made. The approval reference must be recorded against
the transaction at the time of posting. Expenses of USD 1,000 or more without an
approval reference are reported to the Audit Committee quarterly.

## Non-reimbursable

Personal entertainment, airline lounge memberships, spouse or partner travel,
traffic fines, and in-room minibar charges.

         WHERE account_code = ? AND ? BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to

    )
    SELECT DISTINCT code FROM tree
